issue_body:
# Performance regression: both project detail pages below 85

## Summary
Two project detail pages are now simultaneously below the 85 performance threshold with elevated LCP. `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` has been below 85 for **six consecutive nightly audits** with LCP worsening to 4.7 s. `/projects/note-structurer` has dropped from 83 to 79 today with LCP rising to 4.5 s, now firmly below the threshold.

## Score history

### `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue`
| Date | Perf | LCP (ms) | TBT (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-11 | 78 | 4784 | 55 |
| 2026-08-12 | 77 | 4618 | 189 |
| 2026-08-13 | 78 | 4526 | 194 |
| 2026-08-14 | 79 | 4532 | 126 |
| 2026-08-15 | 79 | 4334 | 188 |
| 2026-08-16 | 76 | 4694 | 188 |

### `/projects/note-structurer`
| Date | Perf | LCP (ms) | TBT (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-14 | 82 | 4265 | 117 |
| 2026-08-15 | 83 | 3875 | 162 |
| 2026-08-16 | 79 | 4456 | 161 |

All other scores (accessibility, best practices, SEO) remain 100 on all pages.

## Root cause (likely)
- **Image weight**: Sample thumbnail images (PNG/JPEG at full resolution) on both pages are the primary LCP driver. Converting to WebP at display size (~300 px wide on screenshot-to-primevue) is the single largest win.
- **No lazy loading**: Below-fold images lack `loading="lazy"`, forcing them into the critical path.
- **Drop-zone / demo icon**: The upload-area SVG/icon may be render-blocking; inlining or preloading it would reduce LCP.
- **JS bundle (TBT ~160–190 ms)**: Consistently elevated TBT across both pages suggests shared bundle weight; auditing for unused JS on these routes is warranted.

## Recommended fixes
1. Convert all sample thumbnail and demo images to WebP at display size; serve via `<picture>` or `srcset`.
2. Add `loading="lazy"` to below-fold thumbnail images on both pages.
3. Preload or inline the drop-zone and result-placeholder SVG icons.
4. Code-split or defer non-critical JS on both project detail pages to bring TBT below 100 ms.

## Acceptance criteria
- Lighthouse performance ≥ 85 on both pages on the next nightly audit.
- LCP ≤ 3 500 ms on both pages.
